#Thank you! Thanks, guys, for inspiring me to expand [Dungeon Raiders 2](http://darkinfinitysoftware.com/dungeonraiders2/img/DungeonRaiders-01.JPG)!

This is a free game with no ads! It's just a [digital board game](http://darkinfinitysoftware.com/dungeonraiders2/img/DungeonRaiders-03.JPG) I made for you to play.

#Gimme * [Detailed Instructions & Downloads](http://darkinfinitysoftware.com/dungeonraiders2/) * [Play Store Link](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.DISC.DungeonRaiders2) * [Direct Windows Download (zip file)](http://darkinfinitysoftware.com/dungeonraiders2/DungeonRaiders2v112.zip) * [Direct Linux Download (zip file)](http://darkinfinitysoftware.com/dungeonraiders2/DungeonRaiders2v112l.zip) Let me know if you see any problem with this; I only tested on the latest Ubuntu.

#What did I change? First, I modified the monkey to be like "Slap Jack": the last player to see the monkey loses 25% of their gems. A fan of the game emailed me the idea and I loved it.

I added two adventures! [Poison bottles](http://darkinfinitysoftware.com/dungeonraiders2/img/AdventurePoison.png) can litter a dungeon which indicates that a spider has been killed! In the other adventure, you [catch gems and coins](http://darkinfinitysoftware.com/dungeonraiders2/img/CatchMinigame.png) the spider throws at you while avoiding its spider webs (like a small infinite-runner game).

I modified the achievements. I kept the "Best Score Ever" and "Deepest Explorer" while adding "Most Gems Lost", "Bold", "Timid", and "Skynet" (for when an A.I. player wins the game).

There are some miscellaneous bug fixes and a handful of new graphics, too.

I hope you guys enjoy it. Feel free to leave any questions, comments, or snide remarks below!
